channel.title: JaminZhou Updates
channel.description: Updates from JaminZhou, including the personal homepage, Aperlo, Trailglass, Hushtrail and Rouse for macOS, and PriceBird for iOS.

item.title: Aperlo 1.0.0 for macOS
item.description: Aperlo 1.0.0 is available free on the Mac App Store. Browse images and folders, use native full screen, and enjoy slideshows without importing a library. Supports English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese.

item.title: JaminZhou | Independent Software Studio
item.description: Independent developer building thoughtful apps for Apple platforms including Hushtrail and Rouse for macOS, plus PriceBird for iOS.

item.title: Trailglass 1.0.2 for macOS
item.description: Trailglass 1.0.2 is available on the Mac App Store. Appearance, storage information, and help share one compact Settings window, with clearer spacing and stable window size as information updates.

item.title: Hushtrail for macOS
item.description: Hushtrail is a local-first macOS cleanup utility for reviewing app leftovers and privacy traces inside folders you choose, with preview scans and rollback-backed archive.

item.title: Hushtrail Support
item.description: Support resources and troubleshooting for Hushtrail authorized folders, preview scans, rollback history, browser safety, restore, and discard behavior.

item.title: Hushtrail Privacy Policy
item.description: Privacy details for Hushtrail, including authorized folders, local rollback archives, security-scoped bookmarks, support requests, and Mac App Store data handling.

item.title: PriceBird for iOS
item.description: PriceBird 1.4.2 is the new English brand for the unit-price and price-comparison app, while saved calculations, custom units, currency preferences, and existing support purchases remain available.

item.title: PriceBird Support
item.description: Support resources and FAQs for PriceBird 1.4.2, including unit price calculation, product comparison, anonymous feedback, optional purchases, and compatible Apple silicon Mac use.

item.title: PriceBird Privacy Policy
item.description: Privacy details for PriceBird 1.4.2, including local data, exchange-rate requests, anonymous feedback, and StoreKit purchases.

item.title: Rouse for macOS
item.description: Rouse 1.13.0 is live with independent display sleep control for timed sessions, including a choice of whether the wake session continues or ends when the timer expires.

item.title: Rouse Changelog
item.description: Release notes and version history for Rouse, now updated for Rouse 1.13.0.

item.title: Rouse Support
item.description: Support resources, command line setup notes, FAQs, and contact options for Rouse.

item.title: Rouse Privacy Policy
item.description: Privacy details for Rouse on macOS, including local preferences and command line communication.
